note: S5 step 6 — valve(valve(arr)) == valve(arr). The harness applies arrangement::valve once, then re-applies it to the FOLDED tree (B::valve's output); twice_eq_once asserts the second pass produces the identical stacked-cell arrangement. The un-fold-all-valve-first sweep (balance.jq:204), inherited free by composing B::valve, guarantees this: the second pass strips the prior valve stack back to its computed mode, re-measures feasibility, and re-folds to the same result — measuring on an already-folded node (subtree_min already collapsed) would otherwise latch it stacked forever. This pins that the composition did not break idempotence.
